title: Entropic Risk-Aware Monte Carlo Tree Search
abstract: arXiv:2601.17667v3 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: We propose a provably correct Monte Carlo tree search (MCTS) algorithm for solving risk-aware Markov decision processes (MDPs) with entropic risk measure (ERM) objectives. We provide a non-asymptotic analysis of our proposed algorithm, showing that the algorithm: (i) is correct in the sense that the empirical ERM obtained at the root node converges to the optimal ERM; and (ii) enjoys polynomial regret concentration. Our algorithm successfully exploits the dynamic programming formulations for solving risk-aware MDPs with ERM objectives introduced by previous works in the context of an upper confidence bound-based tree search algorithm. Finally, we provide a set of illustrative experiments to evaluate our risk-aware MCTS method, showing it successfully trades off between risk-neutral and risk-averse behavior.

translated_title: 熵风险感知蒙特卡洛树搜索
translated_abstract: 我们提出了一种可证明正确的蒙特卡洛树搜索（MCTS）算法，用于求解具有熵风险度量（ERM）目标的风险感知马尔可夫决策过程（MDPs）。我们对所提出的算法进行了非渐近分析，表明该算法：（i）在根节点处获得的经验ERM收敛于最优ERM的意义上是正确的；（ii）具有多项式遗憾集中性。我们的算法成功地将先前工作中提出的用于求解具有ERM目标的风险感知MDPs的动态规划公式，应用于基于置信上界的树搜索算法框架中。最后，我们提供了一组说明性实验来评估我们的风险感知MCTS方法，结果表明该方法能够在风险中性和风险规避行为之间成功地进行权衡。
tldr: 提出了一种可证明正确的熵风险感知蒙特卡洛树搜索算法，该算法在根节点处的经验熵风险度量收敛于最优值，并具有多项式遗憾集中性的理论保证，能够在风险中性与风险规避行为之间实现有效权衡。
